title: RollTube
tagline: Decentralized Video Sharing Platform with the features like verifying user's age using decentralized identity, displaying age restricted content and managing Reviews and feedbacks On-Chain with.
description:
Decentralized Video Sharing Platform (On-Chain Management) 

Features 
-Decentralized Identity 
-Access Management (Age Restriction) 
-Reviews and Comments (On-Chain) 
-Perpetual Storage
 
User Flow 
1. Connect your wallet 
2. Create or log in with Polygon Id 
3. View or Upload Videos 
4. Configure Access 
5. Like or comment on videos
how_its_made:
1. We have built the front end on react and used the template provided by the Polygon team.
2. We have written a RollVideo smart contract in solidity and deployed it on the Polygon zkEVM chain. We have used the scaffold-eth template for smart contract development.
3. We are using NFT.Storage for storing and fetching the metadata.
4. We are using the Polygon Id to verify the age of the connected user.
